notes:
Patch 0.1.26

Fix: after download, Manafall was quitting and killing the update installer with it. The game stayed closed, so it looked like a crash on restart.

What changed
- The Apply script now starts detached (survives Manafall closing)
- Auto-Apply is off by default — download finishes, then click Apply when you want to restart
- If Apply still fails, Manafall is relaunched and Manafall-patch-failed.txt is written on the Desktop

This is a small script Apply.
